overall_summary: Recent 7-day performance metrics clearly indicate that high-concept space phenomena, particularly extreme planetary conditions framed with 'What If' hypothetical scenarios, are driving the highest views-per-day, views, and engagement rates (likes-per-view). Videos like 'Venus Has a Day Longer Than Its Year', 'What If You Fell Into a Liquid Diamond Planet?', and 'What If You Fell Into the Planet of Burning Ice?' heavily outperform standard static factoids and psychology/brain tricks published in the same period.

winning_patterns.evidence: IYuce8vaU3Y ('What If You Fell Into a Liquid Diamond Planet?') gained 1024 views with 38 likes and 2 comments; 8KEl0_pJ_68 gained 972 views and 18 likes; YlDuGu1vzAg gained 825 views.
winning_patterns.action: Double down on immersive, high-stakes 'What If' space destruction and exotic planetary immersion formats using vivid visual descriptions.

winning_patterns.evidence: A9Qa-RmuOr0 ('Venus Has a Day Longer Than Its Year') achieved 968 views and 21 likes within a very short timeframe after publication on Oct 1.
winning_patterns.action: Produce more short-form pieces highlighting counter-intuitive planetary physics, weird orbital mechanics, and extreme stellar phenomena.

weak_patterns.evidence: ef3ND4qiRHc ('The Psychological Trick to Stop Songs Stuck in Your Head') stalled at 71 views, and 2fqaGqfsR4A ('Your Brain Can Create Fake Memories') generated only 5 views over the tracking window.
weak_patterns.action: Deprioritize human psychology and brain hack hooks, as they are failing to capture audience retention compared to astronomy and physical science topics.

weak_patterns.pattern: Repetitive Static Space Facts without Narrative Stakes
weak_patterns.evidence: vFXHTmYITp4 ('This Star Is Older Than the Universe!') received only 11 views, proving that flat declarative titles underperform compared to active hypothetical threats.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid static statements; always frame space facts around visceral questions, sensory extremes, or hypothetical viewer immersion.

fresh_topic_constraints: Do not mention diamond planets, burning ice planets, Venus, or gas giant replacements.
Must feature an entirely new astronomical entity with verified scientific backing.

experiment: Test whether framing an interstellar rogue planet around a 'surviving total darkness' sensory hook improves initial viewer retention compared to direct planetary fact drops.
